args: Where the delay accumulates: first-response lag vs. post-response handling time

For Marrowby & Vane, Studio Vrij, and Cragsley Outfitters, does the slowness happen before an agent first replies (pickup delay) or after the first reply, while the ticket is still being worked (handling/back-and-forth delay)?
